description:
## [1.18.0](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/compare/v1.17.0...v1.18.0) (2026-10-22)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **ads:** make Disable ads block what it promises in Castbox, Podcast Republic, Pi Music Player, BeSoccer, Expert Player and Moneycontrol ([40ac9d3](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/40ac9d3c3d730801d6ae3b39c01b3f3a219e7242))
* fail loudly on drift and harden GmsCore support ([7dd00a6](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/7dd00a6284a765eb924d40017e33cf3baf28ef32))
* **kakaotalk,line:** remove KakaoTalk and LINE support ([dd9dd18](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/dd9dd188ef4adbfb5597f779b4adff9d2100c2ab))
* keep only the latest verified version per app and correct the patch notes ([d0f5354](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/d0f5354314601b483cdf0007ded73092668f1ad6))
* **shazam:** open the Spotify login in a browser tab ([7075b7f](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/7075b7fe3815148b016ba8ac435f6020b90ba7a2)), closes [#62](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/issues/62)
* **sofascore,shazam,brave,truecaller:** complete the telemetry, Web Discovery and server-backed premium gates ([8708913](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/8708913a197aba881423f7352f16847619762762))

### ✨ New Features

* **truecaller:** add Disable contact upload ([94b5eca](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/94b5ecaec85fcf23ac97302f4ea6ebf4b03231cb))
* **wemuslim:** add WeMuslim 3.5.4 support ([ef5b416](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/ef5b416ccd58b78a643e9d8fae74388a48013822))

patches.description: Stops Glean telemetry uploads (including the pings that ignore the in-app switch), the daily usage ping, Adjust marketing attribution, Sentry and Socorro crash report uploads and Nimbus experiment downloads. Crashes still show the local crash screen.

patches.name: Enable about:config
patches.description: Opens about:config in release builds, where Firefox normally blocks it.

patches.name: Hide promotional prompts
patches.description: Stops Firefox's own promotions: in-app messages and their notifications, microsurveys, the "Set as default browser" prompts (at start, in onboarding and in the follow-up onboarding days), the onboarding sign-in page and the rating prompt. Sign-in, Set as default browser and Rate on Google Play in settings keep working.

patches.name: Hide sponsored content
patches.description: Hides the sponsored shortcuts on the home screen, sponsored stories and sponsored Firefox Suggest results in the address bar. Regular stories, shortcuts and suggestions stay.

patches.name: Keep background tabs loaded
patches.description: Experimental: keeps the content processes of background tabs at background priority instead of letting them drop to idle, so Android is less likely to kill them and tabs reload less often. Raises memory use, and cannot stop Android from killing the whole app. Shows the last screenshot of a tab while it reloads.

patches.name: Unlock secret settings
patches.description: Reveals the hidden debug menu without tapping the Firefox logo five times: Secret Settings, Install add-on from file, the custom add-on collection, Nimbus experiments, the Sync debug menu and Gecko logs.

patches.name: Add-on support
patches.description: Adds an Extensions menu to install and manage uBlock Origin, Violentmonkey and Tampermonkey, and shows their popups. Add-ons run in private mode, like every Focus tab; their data survives Erase. Installed add-ons are checked for updates from addons.mozilla.org at most once a day.

patches.name: Disable rating prompts
patches.description: Stops the Google Play rating request that opens after a few app starts, and the Play Store page it opens when that request fails.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Stops the daily usage ping, even when its setting is turned on, and Nimbus experiment downloads. The other Glean telemetry is already off in Firefox Focus. Crash reports are still sent only when you choose to send them.

patches.name: Enable about:config
patches.description: Enables about:config, the page for viewing and changing the browser engine's preferences. Type about:config in the address bar to open it.

patches.name: Hide promotional prompts
patches.description: Hides the search widget promotion that opens after erasing your history and the tip bubbles ("Start browsing", tracking protection, erase tabs, privacy settings).

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Hyperion Premium features without a purchase or the Launcher Key app.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes the banner ads and empty ad slots in articles, listings, results and the live programme list, and the pre-roll ads before live channels and videos.

patches.name: Disable live stream ads
patches.description: Plays live channels from the plain stream instead of the Google DAI stream with inserted ads. Turn this off if a live channel stops playing.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring and Piano (Cxense) page events. Push notifications keep working.

patches.name: Disable update prompts
patches.description: Stops the Play Store in-app update prompt. An old version may still stop working if Digi Sport's servers drop support for it.

patches.name: Hide betting odds
patches.description: Hides the bookmaker odds block in soccer match rows.

patches.name: Hide promotions
patches.description: Hides the cross-promotion articles from other RCS&RDS apps below articles and the "Exclusive online · live" bar on Home.

patches.name: Hide sponsored articles
patches.description: Hides sponsored articles in section listings and in the article widgets below an article.

patches.name: Skip ad consent form
patches.description: Skips Google's ad consent form at startup and in the GDPR screens, and hides the then empty ad consent section in Settings. Use it together with Disable ads.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Switches the app to its built-in no-ads provider, removing banner, interstitial and video pre-roll ads (Yandex, Wortise and mediated networks).

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the Pro-only access control settings (parental PIN, locking playlist/EPG/proxy/import-export/recording settings, hiding playlist URLs) and suppresses the in-app review prompt. Start on boot and autoplay last channel are only implemented in the separate IPTV Pro app and stay unavailable.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes the banner and interstitial ads.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes the display and native ads from section fronts, articles and market pages, without leaving empty ad slots, and the pre-roll ads before videos.
